    s = input()

    at_index = s.find("at", 1)

        s = s[:at_index] + "@" + s[at_index + 2:]

    search_start = 1
    while True:
        dot_index = s.find("dot", search_start)
        if dot_index == -1 or dot_index > len(s) - 4:

        s = s[:dot_index] + "." + s[dot_index + 3:]
        search_start = dot_index + 1

    print(s)
